corridor: wharf frontage: 200 native px inside sheet 9's bay-side neatline
why_not_one_block_off: Not a street. Sheet 9 draws the whole wharf yard at 50 ft/in right up to its bay-side neatline (tracks, the slip, the wharf-front blocks), so it owns everything it maps; the seam sits 200 native px (~70 ft) inside its neatline, and the min-ink path within the band settles where the wharf plate's pier sheds end and the block plate's yard begins, as the master's yard cut (D-020) did. The wharf plate supplies only the piers and bay beyond.
